scope: Independent post-worker release inspection, outside the frozen fixture producer graph
license: GPL-3.0-or-later for new checker and portable tests

reuse.transformation: Exact class AST selected from the hash-checked canonical provider; no observer, session or launcher constructed

reuse.origin: Task11 D36 fixture_owner and independent runtime-controls release record
reuse.semantics: Exact recorded process birth identities, output-root handles, and actual shared lock availability are checked independently after the worker; original failed execution status remains failed
reuse.source_limit: Historical independent release producer source was unavailable in the bounded inspected roots. This is record-level semantic reuse, not a claim of verbatim source extraction. Private original evidence remains outside Git.

boundaries: Only explicit completed fixture operation references are consumed; missing case/process evidence is unknown
No runtime process signal, reap, launch, file deletion or old coordination write
Existing global flock is acquired nonblocking and immediately released without creation, truncation or content changes
PID birthtime mismatch is retained as reuse, never classified as an original survivor
A present worker PID without recorded birthtime or unknown group member is uncertain, not confirmed ownership
Unavailable host, permissions, tool, lock or malformed inspection is unknown, not absence
The read-only lsof child has a bounded command timeout; its output is filtered to the declared roots before retention
Inspection is a bounded post-worker observation, not a cryptographic or atomic system snapshot
